title: Cop Fired After Challenging Teen To Fight For Yelling “F**k the Police”
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
A metro Atlanta police officer has been fired after allegedly yelling at a teenager and trying to fight him during a traffic stop. Former officer James Sanders is appealing his termination from the Police Department. He was caught on tape threatening and curing out a 17-year-old boy. But Sanders says he pulled over the passsengers after he heard one of them yell “F---- the police.”

News Articles on this story:
